solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage is about how organizations are enhancing the experience of their frontline workers.
 
• The appropriate word should reflect the idea of making something better.
 
• "**Improving**" fits well as it means to make something better or enhance it, aligning with the context of bettering the employee experience.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 4 is **'improving.'**
 
• Hence, the correct sentence from the passage should read** "...............**** that employ frontline workers have invested in improving__ their employee experience in the past year." **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("regressing", "articulating", "approaching") do not fit the context as effectively. 

 
• **Regressing** (प्रतिगमन करना): "Regressing" means returning to a former or less developed state, which opposite to the idea of improvement.
 
• **Articulating** (व्यक्त करना): "Articulating" means to express something clearly, which does not align with the context of enhancing the employee experience.
 
• **Approaching **(निकट आना): "Approaching" means coming nearer to something, which does not fit the context of making improvements.
